formula: sum(sign * OI * gamma_F * 250000 * F^2 * 0.01), call +1, put -1
coordinate: December futures, Black76, r=0 ACT365, fixed strike IV per price sweep; NOT spot BlackScholes GEX
scope: December2026 only, not all-expiry market gamma; full OI weights are convention, not measured dealer holdings
not_implemented: Actual hedge transactions or validated trading signals
limitations: Incomplete IV chain; OI coverage is not gamma coverage.
Daily option/future last trades not independently synchronized; IV is inferred, not observed historical IV.
Sign reversal reverses gamma; root alone does not establish amplification.
Concentration strikes are not guaranteed support/resistance.
Positive/negative gamma are volatility-regime hypotheses, not rise/fall predictions.
No complete October21 EOD option chain; do not use this as live October21 inventory.
